english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the black bird.

exampleSentences.english: That crow outside the window was so noisy this morning that I couldn't sleep.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰隻烏鴉朝早喺窗外嘈到我瞓唔着。
